title: Tadka Dal
description: Creamy red lentils simmered with turmeric and finished with a sizzling tempering of cumin, garlic, chili and tomato in ghee or oil.

image.alt: A bowl of yellow dal topped with spiced oil, chiles and cilantro

ingredients.prep: rinsed until the water runs clear

steps.text: Bring the lentils, water and turmeric to a boil in the pot, skimming off any foam. Lower the heat and simmer, partly covered and stirring now and then, until the lentils collapse into a thick, creamy soup, {time 20-25 min}. Stir in the salt.
For the tadka, heat the oil in the small skillet over medium heat. Add the cumin seeds and chiles and let them sizzle for {time 30 sec}.
Add the onion and cook until golden, {time 5 min}. Add the garlic and ginger and cook until the garlic is light golden, {time 1 min}. Add the tomato and cook until soft, {time 2-3 min}.
Pour the sizzling tadka over the dal, stir in the garam masala and lemon juice, and scatter with cilantro. Serve with rice or flatbread.

notes: Dal thickens as it cools; add hot water to loosen it before serving leftovers.
Using ghee makes it vegetarian rather than vegan.
